name: screen-analyzer
description: Capture-invisible AI overlay for online meetings: analyze your screen and transcribe call audio without appearing in a screen share
author: krzysztofson

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder
scripts.build:win: npm run typecheck && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run typecheck && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run typecheck && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --linux
